# SidebarMenuRow
Atlas Sidebar Menu Row v1 — a dashboard sidebar row: leading icon, label, optional trailing badge/counter, optional trailing chevron for a collapsible child group. Reference: Stripe sidebar (default/active/expandable rows) + Grok sidebar (expanded/collapsed child disclosure). When to use: the primary row inside a Sidebar shell nav list. When not to use: a top-level app-bar link (use NavBar) or an in-content list row (use List Item). Do: pair with Sidebar Menu Row Child for one level of nested rows; keep the active state color-only (icon + label recolor to primary), no background fill, matching the Stripe reference. Do not: add a background fill to the active state, or give a leaf item (HasChildren=false) a visible chevron. States: default, hover, active (selected leaf or non-expanded parent), expanded (HasChildren=true parent whose children are shown, bolder label plus rotated chevron, distinct from active), disabled. Properties: HasChildren (boolean, shows the trailing chevron), HasBadge (boolean, shows a nested Badge instance for a count or status). Tokens: foreground-muted, foreground, primary, foreground-disabled for icon and label; background-hovered for the hover fill only.
